decisions.decision: Paula will send the oil-water separator form to property owners with a cover letter, a copy of the regulations and a sample form.
decisions.quote: paula noted she would be sending it out to the property owners, along with a cover letter, copy of regulations and a sample form.

decisions.decision: The Emergency Response Plan stays on the agenda until finalized; Paula sends drafts out as they are completed, first to department heads.
decisions.quote: john will keep it on the agenda until it is finalized and paula will send drafts out as they get completed.

decisions.decision: Paula will add the Board of Health and the Water District to the Emergency Response Plan recipient list.
decisions.quote: paula went over the list of recipients and will add the board of health, as well as the water district.

decisions.decision: Paula will contact Leominster (Jake) about impacts and increases in debt service due to the flooding.
decisions.quote: paula will contact jake (leominster) regarding any impacts and increases in debt service due to the flooding.

decisions.decision: Paula will send out the business manager system reports at each meeting so Commissioners know the status of the system.
decisions.quote: she will send out the reports each meeting so commissioners know what is happening with the system.

decisions.decision: Sewer will write an Invitation for Bids (IFB) for the manhole repairs once the ARPA money is available.
decisions.quote: they will need to write up an ifb and she is waiting to find out when the money will be available.

budget_items.topic: Spare pump and pump rebuild kits
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The cost of the spare pump and the rebuild kits was reported.
budget_items.quote: the cost for the spare pump and the rebuild kits was $10,281.27.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager's allocation to Sewer for manhole repairs was reported.
budget_items.quote: sewer was given $100k to address manholes.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission had requested funding to bring the pump stations up to standard.
budget_items.quote: paula added the commission had requested $300k to bring the pump stations up to snuff.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The current connection charge will need to increase because of Leominster's rising costs.
budget_items.quote: the current connection charge of $2,000 will need to increase based on leominster's increasing cost.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Leominster will raise its rates and hook-up charges; the final numbers were not yet known. No dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: john noted that leominster will be increasing their rates and hook-up charges.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A worksheet was prepared to show how rate increases from Leominster and Fitchburg would affect homeowners and businesses. No dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: she also put together a worksheet to look at the impact of what the rate increases from leominster and fitchburg will do.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Remaining manhole repairs for I/I will come from Sewer funds and be reflected in rate increases. No dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: whatever repairs still need to be done to address i/i will need to come from sewer funds and will be reflected in the rate increases.
